Welcome to High View Primary School
A Message from the Head teacher
We are dedicated to the holistic development of every child. From the moment they enter, we create a nurturing environment that challenges and supports them. Our teachers work tirelessly to foster each learner's unique potential. We maintain high expectations, ensuring every pupil progresses academically and personally.
Learning is enhanced through extracurricular activities, such as performing arts and forest school learning. Our mantra, 'Speak Up. Be Heard. Create Change' encourages students to voice concerns and effect change. We cultivate perseverance, respect, and responsibility, ensuring that children are not only prepared for the future but also equipped to thrive in an interconnected world.
At High View we pride ourselves on shaping capable and confident individuals ready for the next steps in life.

Welcome to High View Primary School
Aims, Visions & Values
Aims, Visions & Values
Opportunities to Thrive
Our Vision
High View provides an exciting and memorable journey, where each child thrives and becomes the greatest version of themselves. Our children discover and develop knowledge, talents and skills; creating a positive and lifelong impact.
Our Mission
Children are consistently engaged in purposeful and exciting learning; giving them the knowledge and values needed to thrive in the world we live in today and the world they will create in the future.
Our Aim
Through broad, balanced and diverse opportunities, our school values are instilled within each child and throughout our school community.
Our Values
Responsibility - we do what is right. We learn from achievement and we learn from mistakes; taking ownership of our actions. Belonging - we are a diverse community where we all feel we belong. Perseverance - we are challenged. We ask for help. We try again. We succeed. Self-Belief - we speak up, we are heard, we create change. Respect - we respect life, culture, property and opinions. Creativity - we use our imagination creatively, every day. Curiosity - we ask questions knowing there may be many answers, or no answer at all.

Challenge Partners Network of Excellence
Each year, a Challenge Partners team of reviewers quality assures and assesses our school's effectiveness. This means that senior leaders from other schools, led by a lead reviewer, work together with our school leaders with the goal of identifying and improving good practice. Through collaboration, challenge and professional development, the Challenge Partners network aims to ensure every school can benefit from the combined wisdom of the education system. pageCache.pageTitle: High View Primary School - Nursery & Reception Entry September 2027 - Prospective Parent School Tours
pageCache.text:
Welcome to High View Primary School
Nursery & Reception Entry September 2027 - Prospective Parent School Tours
School Tours for prospective parents of children eligible to join our school in Nursery or Reception in September 2027.
School tours for parents looking for entry into our Nursery or Reception for September 2027, will take place in the Autumn Term at the start of the academic year (26-27).
This is so they coincide with the dates the application processes are open.
You will be taken on a full tour of our school and will then have a presentation from our Head Teacher (or another member of our Senior Management Team). The tour will take approximately 40 mins and will start promptly at the advertised start time.
Tour tours are limited to 10 people per group and each session will have two groups touring at the same time (20 people per session). The tours are aimed at parents, young children tend to find the format boring. Should your child be allocated a place at our school, they will have the opportunity to come in and visit the school as part of their welcome programme.
If you do need to bring young children along with you, you may wish to bring a quiet activity with you to keep them occupied. Due to limited space in our corridors and stairs to our upper floor, any buggies/pushchairs will be stored securely whilst the tour takes place.
Tour Dates - Please click on the date to book via Eventbrite
Friday 16th October 2026 -9.30am
Friday 16th October 2026 -10.30am
Thursday 5th November 2026 -9.30am
Thursday 5th November 2026 -10.30am
Wednesday 18th November 2026 -9.30am
Wednesday 18th November 2026 - 10.30am
Friday 8th January 2027 -9.30am
Friday 8th January 2027 - 10.30am
If you have any admissions queries, please contact High View School Office on 0208 688 3563 Option 2
Reception Intake September 2027
The national application process for entry into Reception in September 2027, will open on 1st September 2026 and closes on 15th January 2027. Applications for Reception places are made directly to the local authority in which you reside.
Nursery Intake September 2027 - updated 2nd September 2026
Applications for nursery places are managed by each nursery setting. There is no central point to apply to.
The application process for entry in our nursery for the school year Sep 27 to July 26, will open mid October 26. Full details of our nursery provision and a link to our application form will be published on our nursery admissions page at that time.
If you have any queries, please contact the High View School Office on 0208 688 3563.
We look forward to meeting you on one of our future tours.
